exports.name: dispose
exports.reason: teardown: it frees the host by design, and it is also the boot-failure path

exports.name: render_allocation_count
exports.reason: the reader of the render-locked allocation count

exports.name: service
exports.reason: single-mode control work (#1381a): the service step reclaims the displaced plan and its attachment, so its frees are control allocations, counted in the control counter, and it runs in the message handler, never in process() or a render-locked window

exports.name: control_request_ptr
exports.reason: single-mode control work (#1562a D1): the staging address of one control frame, read in the message handler, never in process() or a render-locked window

exports.name: replace_document_ptr
exports.reason: single-mode control work (#1697): it stages the document a SESSION_REPLACE frame names, read in the message handler, so its allocation is a control allocation, counted in the control counter, and never a render-locked window's

exports.name: control_command
exports.reason: single-mode control work (#1562a D1): it runs SessionState::command in the message handler, so its allocations are control allocations, counted in the control counter, and never a render-locked window's

exports.name: watermark_read
exports.reason: single-mode control work (#1294a): it copies the applied-revision watermark into its fixed record, read in the message handler after each service step, never in process() or a render-locked window

exports.name: session_seek
exports.reason: single-mode control work (#1644 D1): it seeks the timeline and every source through SessionState in the message handler, between blocks, so its allocations are control allocations, counted in the control counter, and never in process() or a render-locked window

exports.name: session_seek_at
exports.reason: single-mode control work (#1644 D1): the anchored form of session_seek, in the same message handler, between blocks, never in process() or a render-locked window

exports.name: source_seek_at
exports.reason: single-mode control work (#1297a): it runs SessionState::seek_at, which runs the service step first, in the message handler, between blocks, so its allocations are control allocations, counted in the control counter, and never in process() or a render-locked window; the feed drain never calls it

exports.name: source_seek_report
exports.reason: single-mode control work (#1297a): it runs SessionState::seek_report, which runs the service step first, in the message handler, between blocks, never in process() or a render-locked window; the feed drain never calls it

exports.name: control_event
exports.reason: single-mode control work (#1570b D1): it dequeues one protocol event through SessionState::dequeue_event, which runs the service step and encodes the frame, so its allocations are control allocations, counted in the control counter; the worklet drains both lanes in the message handler after each message, never in process() or a render-locked window

exports.name: control_response_ptr
exports.reason: single-mode control work (#1562a D1): the address of the last control response, read in the message handler

exports.name: control_response_bytes
exports.reason: single-mode control work (#1562a D1): the length of the last control response, read in the message handler

exports.name: control_revision
exports.reason: single-mode control work (#1562a, carry-forward 2): the committed revision the SDK's queue seeds from, read in the message handler

exports.name: meter_header_ptr
exports.reason: single-mode control work (#1290d1): the address of the header the host publishes the meter frame through, read in the message handler to cut the views over a replacement plan's frame and (#1562b) to read the rendering plan's structure epoch for the observation map, never in process() or a render-locked window

exports.name: control_allocation_count
exports.reason: the reader of the control allocation count, which the status reports as singleModeControlAllocations
